effects.title: Turn Undead
effects.description: A sacred seal releases searing caster-centered light and rapid radiant echoes.

effects.title: Fireball
effects.description: A side-on bolt detonates in a top-down blast, leaving fissures and embers that fade.

effects.title: Fireball Opening
effects.description: The same fireball impact settles into persistent burning ground.

effects.title: Fireball Embers
effects.description: Scorched fissures breathe with hot coals and drifting embers.

effects.title: Fireball Closing
effects.description: Burning ground cools and its scorch marks disappear.

effects.title: Rift
effects.description: Neon slit with an opaque dark tear.

effects.title: Miasma Pool
effects.description: Smoky ground pools with billowing vents.

effects.title: Vortex
effects.description: Layered outward spirals with a shimmering core.

effects.title: Vortex Open
effects.description: Outward spirals with a transparent center.

effects.title: Vortex Black Hole
effects.description: Circular dark core with a photon ring and orbiting light.

effects.title: Teleport Departure
effects.description: Power gathers inward, flashes, then scatters into sparks.

effects.title: Teleport Arrival
effects.description: An arrival flash expands into rings and curling wisps.

effects.title: Impact Burst
effects.description: A sharp flash, traveling sparks, and an expanding shock ring.

effects.title: Ground Eruption
effects.description: Top-down branching cracks vent energy through the floor.

effects.title: Casting Release
effects.description: Varied runes gather power, then discharge in a burst.

effects.title: Dispel
effects.description: A rune ward fractures into drifting glyph fragments.

sequences.title: Fireball sequence
sequences.description: Incoming bolt, explosive impact, sustained burning ground, then fade.

sequences.title: Rift sequence
sequences.description: Open, sustain the loop, then close at a loop boundary.

sequences.title: Vortex sequence
sequences.description: Open, sustain the loop, then close at a loop boundary.
